title: Global operator of a correspondence
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and the finite coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let $X$ and $C$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with structure morphisms $a_X$ and $a_C$. Let $c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_sX$ and $u:Lc_2^*K\to Rc_1^!K$, for $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, be a cohomological correspondence as in [def-trf-correspondence], with the constructible exceptional adjunction of [def-trf-admissibility]. Assume that the ordinary leg $c_2$ is proper. All operations below are at the same finite coefficient stage $A$.

Use the derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image], derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and compact-support direct image [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For the complexes occurring below, write
$$
R\Gamma_c(Z,M)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Z!}M)
$$
as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. The formal composite before applying $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ is the global-operator construction of [sk-d-operator]. Here its components are evaluated on the stated constructible objects using the canonical adjunctions and comparisons specified below; no unrestricted ambient exceptional adjoint is required. The global operator of $u$ is the resulting composite endomorphism in $D(A)$
$$
\begin{aligned}
T_c(u):R\Gamma_c(X,K)&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma_c(X,\eta_{c_2,K})}
R\Gamma_c(X,Rc_{2*}Lc_2^*K)
\xrightarrow{\alpha_{c_2,Lc_2^*K}}
R\Gamma_c(C,Lc_2^*K)\\
&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma_c(C,u)}
R\Gamma_c(C,Rc_1^!K)
\xrightarrow{\gamma_{c_1,Rc_1^!K}^{-1}}
R\Gamma_c(X,Rc_{1!}Rc_1^!K)\\
&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma_c(X,\varepsilon_{c_1,K})}
R\Gamma_c(X,K).
\end{aligned}
$$
Here the maps and isomorphisms have the following specified meanings.

1. $\eta_{c_2,K}:K\to Rc_{2*}Lc_2^*K$ is the unit at $K$ of $Lc_2^*\dashv Rc_{2*}$, given by clause (1) of [fix-prop-adjunctions].
2. Write $p_f:Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*$ for the proper-coincidence isomorphism for a proper $f$, and $\gamma_f:Ra_{X!}Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra_{C!}$ for compact-support composition when $f:C\to X$ and $a_X\circ f=a_C$. Both are the canonical comparisons of clause (3) of [prop-functor-package], with its identity and associativity compatibilities. Then
$$
\alpha_{c_2,M}=\operatorname{Fib}_s(\gamma_{c_2,M})\circ
\operatorname{Fib}_s\bigl(Ra_{X!}(p_{c_2,M}^{-1})\bigr):
R\Gamma_c(X,Rc_{2*}M)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_c(C,M).
$$
In the displayed composite, $\gamma_{c_1,N}^{-1}$ denotes the image under $\operatorname{Fib}_s$ of the inverse composition isomorphism, evaluated at $N=Rc_1^!K$.
3. $\varepsilon_{c_1,K}:Rc_{1!}Rc_1^!K\to K$ is the counit at $K$ of the constructible adjunction $Rc_{1!}\dashv Rc_1^!$ specified in [def-trf-admissibility].

Thus both intermediate identifications use compact-support composition; the first also uses the properness of $c_2$.

blueprint_update.statement:
In the setting of [def-trf-correspondence], assume that the
ordinary leg $c_2$ is
proper. The
*global operator* of a correspondence $u$ is

$$
T_c(u):R\Gamma_c(X,K)\longrightarrow R\Gamma_c(X,K),
$$

the composite

$$
\begin{aligned}
R\Gamma_c(X,K)&\xrightarrow{\eta^*_{c_2}}
R\Gamma_c(X,Rc_{2*}Lc_2^*K)
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }R\Gamma_c(C,Lc_2^*K)\\
&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma_c(C,u)}
R\Gamma_c(C,Rc_1^!K)
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }R\Gamma_c(X,Rc_{1!}Rc_1^!K)\\
&\xrightarrow{R\Gamma_c(X,\varepsilon_{c_1})}R\Gamma_c(X,K),
\end{aligned}
$$

where $R\Gamma_c$ is the compact-support cohomology of the
coefficient conventions
(computed with the
compact-support direct
image), and:

1. the first arrow is the unit of the adjunction
$Lc_2^*\dashv Rc_{2*}$ of the
derived direct image, applied
to $K$ on $X$: this is the canonical arrow $K\to Rc_{2*}Lc_2^*K$;
1. the first isomorphism is the identification $Rc_{2*}\simeq Rc_{2!}$ for the
proper $c_2$ (the
proper-coincidence clause of the six-operations package,
[prop-functor-package], item (3)), applied to $Lc_2^*K$ and
composed with the identity naturality of the compact-support
construction;
1. the second isomorphism is the *composition law* of the
compact-support direct image for the composite
$a_X\circ c_1=a_C$ ([prop-functor-package], item (3)),
$$
Ra_{X!}Rc_{1!}\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }R(a_X\circ c_1)_!=Ra_{C!},
$$
which is correctly an isomorphism of functors with the associativity
compatibility: this arrow transports the compact-support cohomology of
$C$ to that of $X$ along the exceptional leg (it is *not* the
projection formula);
1. the last arrow is the counit
$\varepsilon_{c_1}:Rc_{1!}Rc_1^!\to\operatorname{id}$ of the
adjunction $Rc_{1!}\dashv Rc_1^!$ of [def-trf-admissibility],
applied to $K$ and then to
$R\Gamma_c(X,-)$ (exact, so it maps the counit to an arrow in the
derived category).

The composite is a morphism of $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$
by [lem-trf-global-operator-perfect].
